Ovarian cystadenoma: Family history: mother had a history of ovarian cysts
Cyst location: extending from the liver to the pelvis and involving the uterus and ovaries
Cyst characteristics: fluid density of 20 Hounsfield units, no calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations
Laboratory studies: α-fetoprotein, carcinoembryonic antigen, cancer antigen 19-9, and cancer antigen 125 were all within normal limits
